about.title: About
about.description: Ludo 2 is a real-time multiplayer implementation of the classic board game Ludo, supporting 4 to 8 players.
about.openSource: This project is open source. Its complete source code is hosted on GitHub, where feedback is welcome.
about.issues: If you encounter a bug or would like to request a feature, please open a report on the GitHub issue tracker.
about.builtWith: Vue 3, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Bun.
about.privacy: No cookies, no tracking, no analytics. The game stores only your session and preferences (theme, language, sound) on your device, and all fonts are served from this site — your data is never sent to third parties.

howto.title: How to Play
howto.intro: Ludo 2 is a turn-based race game for 4 to 8 players. Each player commands four tokens and aims to move them around a shared track and into their home column. All rules are enforced by the server; the client only displays the synchronized game state.

objective.title: 1. Objective
items: Be the first player to bring all four of your tokens from your base, around the full track, and into your home column.

setup.title: 2. Setup
items: A match is played by between 4 and 8 players.
Each player is assigned a colour and controls four tokens.
All tokens begin in their owner's base, off the track.
Seating and turn order are fixed once the game begins.

turn.title: 3. Taking a Turn
items: On your turn, roll the single die.
A token may leave the base and enter the track only when you roll a six.
After rolling, you must move one eligible token by the number shown, provided a legal move exists.
If no legal move is available, your turn is passed automatically.

movement.title: 4. Moving Tokens
items: Tokens travel along the shared track in a single fixed direction.
After completing the circuit, a token turns into its own home column.
Entering the final home cell requires an exact roll; a roll that would overshoot the end is not a legal move.

capturing.title: 5. Capturing
items: Landing on a track cell occupied by a single opponent token sends that token back to its base.
Each player's start square is a safe square; a token resting on a safe square cannot be captured.
Tokens inside a home column cannot be captured.

sixes.title: 6. Rolling a Six
items: Rolling a six grants you an additional turn.
Rolling three sixes in succession forfeits the turn: the third six is void and play passes to the next player.

winning.title: 7. Winning
items: A player finishes once all four of their tokens occupy their home column.
Remaining players continue, and are ranked in the order they finish.

options.title: 8. Optional Rules
items: Walls: when enabled, two of your tokens on the same cell form a wall that blocks opponents from passing or capturing.
Auto-move: when enabled, a turn with only one legal move is played automatically.
Turn timer: when enabled, each turn is capped at 30 seconds; a player who misses three turns is removed from the game.
